items.title: Chainlit AI framework bugs let hackers breach cloud environments
items.description: Two high-severity vulnerabilities in Chainlit, a popular open-source framework for building conversational AI applications, allow reading any file on the server and leak sensitive information. [...]

items.title: Cisco fixes Unified Communications RCE zero day exploited in attacks
items.description: Cisco has fixed a critical Unified Communications and Webex Calling remote code execution vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-20045, that has been actively exploited as a zero-day in attacks. [...]

items.title: 'Contagious Interview' Attack Now Delivers Backdoor Via VS Code
items.description: Once trust is granted to the repository's author, a malicious app executes arbitrary commands on the victim's system with no other user interaction.
